checks_run.procedure: Live stack: fresh PostgreSQL, migrate (twice), seed SYNTHETIC dev users, start the API (AUTH_MODE=dev) and the worker as separate processes, then run the HTTP probe (01a). It covers: the close rule (draft/active/on_hold→closed refused 422, record and version unchanged, a combined close+rename refused atomically, no audit event for a refused close, refusal text names product gate G6 and never DG7 or an approval); defaults Asia/Riyadh and SAR, and configurability; End-to-End starts in Diagnose and Modular enters at the selected phase; If-Match 428/409; CSRF 403; scoped access (TL out-of-scope 404, TL list filtered, ADM_ACCESS/ADM_TECH see no business records, AUD read-only 403, no-role user empty); cursor pagination (complete ordered walk, cursor bound to the filter, tamper and limit 400); branding tokens; preferences; outbox consumed by the worker. Then SIGTERM the worker and probe the API.
checks_run.environment: Disposable clone at 2c22c27; Node 22.22.2; PostgreSQL 16.13; API on localhost:3000; synthetic data only
checks_run.expected: every probe assertion passes; worker exits cleanly; API stays ready after the worker stops
checks_run.actual: SUMMARY pass=34 fail=0 (probe exit=0). Refused close: 422 urn:mth:problem:invalid-transition 'Closure requires the G6 (Sustain) business approval with validated benefits, which is not available in this release.'; record stays active, same version. Audit: create + 2 updates, nothing for refused attempts. Outbox transformation.created 7/7 published. Worker SIGTERM exit=0; API alive; /readyz 200 afterwards. The wrapper's own final exit status is 1 only because its trailing `grep -c` of API errors counted 0 matches.

summary: PASS. The DG1 candidate sha256:25c97340… is faithful to the playbook and master prompt for the P1 scope. Closure is refused with 422 and attributed to product gate G6, never DG7. Scoped access, identity, CSRF, optimistic concurrency and cursor pagination behave correctly on a live stack. The API survives a worker stop. Rendering is Arabic RTL by default and English LTR, with bundled fonts and no external requests. The wordmark and the seven tokens are provisional, and nothing claims official PMI status, certification or Mobily brand compliance. All required checks ran and passed on Node 22 and Node 24. Three Low, non-mandatory documentation and traceability findings: F-DG1-001, F-DG1-002, F-DG1-003.
